|eyes = Dark brown}}'''Jeaine Caide''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Green Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jeaine Caide}} She was also [[Black Ajah]] and a member of [[Liandrin's Group of Black Sisters|Liandrin's group of Black sisters]].

== Appearance and Personality==
Jeaine had the appearance of a typical [[Domani]], with coppery skin and a swan neck. She had dark brown eyes.

She detested men, and chose Green partly so she could beguile and control them. Yet, she was not attracted to women.

== Strength and Abilities==
Jeane is of [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|high average]] strength for an Aes Sedai, with a [[One Power]] level of {{opsl|24}}. She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to [[Traveling|Travel]]. We can assume that all Black Ajah that took part in the [[Last Battle]] were taught the weave.

== History ==
Jeaine was born in {{ne|912}} and went to the [[White Tower]] in {{ne|928}}. After spending six years as a [[novice]] and six years as [[Accepted]], she was raised to the shawl in {{ne|940}}.

She was one of the seven Aes Sedai that escorted [[Siuan Sanche]] and [[Moiraine Damodred]] to [[Tamra Ospenya]] when they were to be raised from Accepted to Aes Sedai and swear the [[Three Oaths]]. It is unknown if she was Black at the time already or not.

== Activities ==
After fleeing the [[White Tower]] with her group she went to [[Tear]] and worked for the [[Forsaken]] [[Be'lal]]. They tried to trap [[Rand al'Thor]] just after he released ''[[Callandor]]''.{{Ref/book|3|51}}

When this failed they fled to [[Tarabon]]. During the trip in a ship, Jeaine tried to use one of the ''[[ter'angreal]]'' stolen by them. This [[fluted black rod]] produced a bar of [[balefire]] that nearly sunk the ship.{{ref/book|4|38}}

In [[Tanchico]] they tried to steal the male ''[[a'dam]]'' from the [[Panarch]]'s Palace. There she used the ''ter'angreal'' weaving [[balefire]] in the attempt to kill [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] after Nynaeve had defeated the Forsaken [[Moghedien]]. After she missed, Nynaeve was wondering if the uncontrollable ''ter'angreal'' killed Jeaine. {{Ref/book|4|54}}

When Moghedien took over Liandrin's group in [[Amador]], she assigned Jeaine a task to which she reacted with horror.{{ref/book|5|18}}

Regardless of what her task from Moghedien was or if it was carried out or not, Jeaine was killed by [[Thomdril Merrilin]] at [[Shayol Ghul]] in the [[Tarmon Gai'don|Last Battle]] while trying to sneak inside the [[Pit of Doom]] using the [[Mask of Mirrors]] to pose as [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]].{{ref/book|14|44}}
